notes.title: 0.0.6.31 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Now available on Mac OSX
- New game mode: Domination
- Vote map/mode system
- Checkpoints added to single player

notes.title: 0.0.6.22 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Keep same simulation speed if below 60 FPS (minimum 30 FPS)
- Rebalanced single player
- Added Steam Cloud support for saving games
- Changes for easier gamepad aiming
- Various bug fixes

notes.title: 0.0.6.20 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Disarm now causes you to drop the ball (Jellybot's discharge and Vertigo's EMP Orb)
- Added keyboard/mouse controls rebinding
- fixed a bug where ability cooldowns on server and client would get de-synced
- fixed persistent chat window bug
- various other bugs

notes.title: 0.0.6.16 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-Fixed window on wrong screen in fullscreen mode
-Fixed windowed mode undraggable on some monitor setups
-Rebalanced single player
-Fixed no space bug in launch param server name

notes.title: 0.0.6.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-added more settings to disable textures and post processing to aid low end GPUs
-Vertigo has a smaller clip size
-Axle attacks faster
-Huck attacks faster, and his grenades launch faster and farther
-Further reduce spawn times with less players

notes.title: 0.0.6.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Further reduction of load times, both at startup and between levels
- Added time limit to multiplayer games
- Re-balance of single player
- Added animation feedback to ball possession
- Fixed bug where controllers couldn't select map in join screen
- Added command line parameters for dedicated servers
  Ex. -startup_map Nest server_name NantuksGreatServer

notes.title: 0.0.6.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Spun up a few more official dedicated servers
- Added a chat system to the multiplayer
- Rebalanced single player levels slightly (more to come soon)
- Greatly reduced initial load time.
- Various bug fixes
